dedupe_keys.name: epa lmop landfill and landfill gas energy project database

description: The LMOP Landfill and Landfill Gas Energy Database holds data on more than 2,600 municipal solid waste landfills in the United States that are accepting waste or closed in the past few decades, and on landfill gas energy projects at them. Landfill records give location, operational status, design capacity and gas collection status; project records give status (planned, under construction, operational or shut down), start date, size and technology. As of September 2024, 488 landfills supplied gas to 542 operating projects. The producer is the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's Landfill Methane Outreach Program, which compiles voluntary partner reports, Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program Subpart HH data (cross-referenced by facility identifier) and public information. Coverage is national at site level. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Public domain (EPA web policy: EPA-produced data are in the public domain unless otherwise specified). Access is free of charge. Caveats: the database is not exhaustive, omits industrial and hazardous waste landfills, is not updated for every site each year, and EPA warns the composite file should not be used for summations. Simulation uses: an inventory of waste disposal capacity for waste system capacity planning and disruption studies, and methane and energy recovery scenarios for climate work. Related records: the What a Waste global database (data-what-a-waste-global-database) and the SWOLF life-cycle model (model-swolfpy).
